blocks.text: Effortlessly chic. Always efficient. A 15-inch laptop with a built-in HD camera, enlarged ergonomic keyboard and Intel Core 3 processor.

items: Effortlessly chic. Always efficient. Finish your to-do list in no time with the Dell 15, built for everyday computing with Intel Core 3 processor.

items.label: Designed for easy learning
items.value: Energy-efficient batteries and Express Charge support extend your focus and productivity.

items.label: Stay connected to what you love
items.value: Spend more screen time on the things you enjoy with Dell ComfortView software that helps reduce harmful blue light emissions to keep your eyes comfortable over extended viewing times.

items.label: Type with ease
items.value: Write and calculate quickly with roomy keypads, separate numeric keypad and calculator hotkey.

items.label: Ergonomic support
items.value: Keep your wrists comfortable with lifted hinges that provide an ergonomic typing angle.

items.label: Dell Services
items.value: 1 Year Onsite Service provides support when and where you need it. Dell will come to your home, office, or location of choice, if an issue covered by Limited Hardware Warranty cannot be resolved remotely.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, Memory Card Slot

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: USB devices, External displays via HDMI, Bluetooth devices, Wi-Fi enabled devices
